blocks.text: HSBC Philippines recently brought its refreshed HSBC Premier proposition to Cebu with an evening that explored how banking can support lives shaped by international opportunities, personal ambitions, and connections across the world. Held at the Grand Ballroom of Shangri-La Mactan, the Life’s Premier event welcomed clients, business leaders, partners, and members of the Cebu community. Through interactive experiences centered on Wealth, Health, Travel, and International, guests discovered how HSBC Premier brings financial priorities and lifestyle needs together. “Our customers’ ambitions reach far beyond where they live, and their banking partner must be able to keep pace,” said HSBC Philippines CEO and […]...
